title: gossip
summary: MSUI implements CMSG_GOSSIP_HELLO, CMSG_GOSSIP_SELECT_OPTION, CMSG_NPC_TEXT_QUERY, SMSG_GOSSIP_MESSAGE, SMSG_GOSSIP_COMPLETE, and the complete eight-block SMSG_NPC_TEXT_UPDATE record. It caches the undrawn record by text id and re-draws per menu open using the NPC descriptor gender, reference [1,2) random-roll shape, weighted <= selection over non-empty chosen-column text, and no cross-gender fallback.

openItems.text: Greeting selection: GossipPackets.ParseText keeps only block 0 of the 8 SMSG_NPC_TEXT_UPDATE blocks (probabilities skipped), instead of Benilla's select_greeting weighted draw with NPC-gender column choice - multi-block NPC texts always show the first block regardless of weights
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: ParseText retains all eight weighted gender pairs; GossipUiLaw implements the exact chosen-column weighted draw (including <= and all-zero behavior); GameLoop caches records, re-draws on each open, and selects from the live NPC gender. Focused packet/law/runtime checks pass.
